summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid/invalid cases and non-node input tests. The 38 tests in the new module and test/test_path.py pass under the shared venv. mypy, black, and isort are not installed in that venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. One deviation from the spec: an explicit isinstance(..., Node) guard rejects None and plain strings before any graph lookup, because graph.value(None, ...) would act as a wildcard. Nothing is committed, and no existing modules were changed.
